FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 3

LIMIT 5

calls.statement:
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.store_key = 13
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 3

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS line_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS distinct_products
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.store_key = 13
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) AS returned_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.store_key = 13
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 3

SELECT 
  f.sale_date,
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.store_key = 13
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY f.sale_date, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY f.sale_date
LIMIT 10
